risks.risk: Burners may not ignite properly (or may ignite but have weak/uneven flame).
risks.proof: Short video clip of lighting all 4 burners (including ignition/spark) and showing stable blue flame for a few seconds each.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as needs service/unknown ignition).

risks.risk: Oven may not heat correctly (temperature control/thermostat or burner issue).
risks.proof: Video clip of oven ignition and a thermometer reading after a few minutes (or a clear demonstration of heating).
risks.if_unproven: Price as oven performance unproven (worst case: treat as not reliably heating).

risks.risk: Gas leaks or faulty seals/hoses/valves (safety risk).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of leak test result (soapy water bubbles at joints) or a professional gas test report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as safety not verified (worst case: assume may require inspection).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect parts (e.g., burner caps, igniter components) or damaged burner heads.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each burner head/cap and the igniter area; confirm all parts are present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as parts condition unknown (worst case: assume some parts may be worn).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than described (refurbished/barely used) due to wear not captured fully.
risks.proof: Extra photos of the underside/edges and the oven interior racks/hinges for wear and rust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition (worst case: not 'barely used').

proof_requests: Video: light all 4 burners one by one (show ignition and stable flame).
Video: ignite the oven and show it heating for a few minutes (ideally with a thermometer).
Photos/clip: close-ups of burner heads/caps and the igniter area.
Leak test proof: soapy-water bubble check at gas joints/valves (or a gas technician report).
Photo of the receipt/warranty card (showing date and serial/model if available).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a standing gas cooker (brand text visible), but there is no working test shown. Since 'perfect working condition' and 'barely used' are unverified, the safest approach is to request ignition/oven and safety proof before pricing.
